prompt: Create a square 1:1 futuristic promotional graphic for CAVN announcing GPT IMAGE 2.. Use a dark navy-to-black background with a warm orange glow on the right edge and subtle blue light on the left. At the top left, place bold uppercase text in three parts: small white “NOW ON”, bright pink “CAVN:” on the same line, and a huge white headline “GPT IMAGE 2.” beneath it in a clean geometric sans-serif font. The central focus is one large tilted transparent glass screen with rounded corners and glowing beveled edges, spanning most of the lower center. Inside this main screen, show a split AI-generation effect: the left half is dark blue digital pixels and square mosaic fragments, while the right half resolves into a cinematic fantasy landscape with mountains, a calm lake, rocks, clouds, and sunset light. A bright electric audio waveform made of luminous blue, white, and purple curves enters from the left and passes through the main screen, suggesting music becoming imagery. Add exactly 3 glass image panels: 1 large central landscape panel, 1 smaller floating rounded-rectangle panel near the upper right showing a moonlit mountain lake scene, and 1 smaller floating rounded-rectangle panel near the lower right showing a warm fantasy castle or spire landscape. All panels should have glossy transparent edges, reflections, and orange-blue rim lighting. In the bottom left, include a small gradient audio-wave logo icon with the white text cavn.ai. Visual style: premium tech launch poster, high-detail 3D glassmorphism, cinematic lighting, sharp typography, glowing particles, digital mosaic squares, polished album-art promotional aesthetic. Constraints: keep the composition uncluttered, use only the visible text “NOW ON CAVN:”, “GPT IMAGE 2.”, and “cavn.ai”, no extra copy, no watermark.

promptZh: 创建一个 1:1 的方形未来感宣传图，用于宣布 CAVN 上的 GPT IMAGE 2。。使用深海军蓝到黑色的背景，右侧边缘带有温暖的橙色光晕，左侧带有微妙的蓝色光线。在左上角，分三部分放置粗体大写文字：小号白色“NOW ON”，同一行亮粉色“CAVN:”，以及下方巨大的白色标题“GPT IMAGE 2。”，使用简洁的几何无衬线字体。中心焦点是一个巨大的倾斜透明玻璃屏幕，具有圆角和发光的斜面边缘，占据了下方的中心大部分区域。在这个主屏幕内，展示一种分裂的 AI 生成效果：左半部分是深蓝色数字像素和方形马赛克碎片，而右半部分则呈现为电影般的奇幻景观，包含山脉、宁静的湖泊、岩石、云朵和日落光影。一条由明亮的蓝色、白色和紫色曲线组成的电音波形从左侧进入并穿过主屏幕，暗示音乐转化为图像的过程。添加 3 个玻璃图像面板：1 个大型中央景观面板，1 个位于右上角附近较小的悬浮圆角矩形面板（展示月光下的山湖场景），以及 1 个位于右下角附近较小的悬浮圆角矩形面板（展示温暖的奇幻城堡或尖塔景观）。所有面板都应具有光泽的透明边缘、反射效果以及橙蓝色的轮廓光。在左下角，包含一个小型的渐变音频波浪图标，并附带白色文字 cavn.ai。视觉风格：高端科技发布海报、高细节 3D 玻璃拟态、电影级灯光、锐利的排版、发光粒子、数字马赛克方块、精致的专辑封面推广美学。约束：保持构图简洁，仅使用可见文字“NOW ON CAVN:”、“GPT IMAGE 2。”和“cavn.ai”，无额外文案，无水印。
